mapper.select: select f.favorite_id, f.user_id, f.service_id, f.create_time, s.service_name, s.service_intro, s.product_image as image_url, s.price, u.unit_name, s.status as service_status from zjudg_user_favorite f left join zjudg_service s on s.service_id = f.service_id left join zjudg_service_unit u on u.unit_id = s.unit_id where f.user_id = #{userId} order by f.create_time desc
select f.favorite_id, f.user_id, f.service_id, f.create_time from zjudg_user_favorite f where f.user_id = #{userId} and f.service_id = #{serviceId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into zjudg_user_favorite(favorite_id, user_id, service_id, create_time) values(#{favoriteId}, #{userId}, #{serviceId}, sysdate())
mapper.delete: delete from zjudg_user_favorite where user_id = #{userId} and service_id = #{serviceId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from zjudg_user_favorite where user_id = #{userId}
select count(1) from zjudg_user_favorite where service_id = #{serviceId}
